description: Defines the UccServer class, which handles receiving CAPI commands and sending replies in the UCC framework used by prplMesh. It includes methods for setting command handlers, sending replies, and notifying received commands.

classes.name: UccServer
classes.description: Abstract class representing a server component for handling UCC commands and replies.

methods.name: set_command_received_handler
methods.description: Sets the callback function to handle received UCC commands.

methods.name: clear_command_received_handler
methods.description: Clears the previously set command handler.

methods.name: send_reply
methods.description: Pure virtual function to send a reply string to a client.

methods.name: notify_command_received
methods.description: Notifies the handler of a received command.
